capabilities: Display a random vault note in a modal on app startup
Restrict note selection to a chosen directory
Open the source file of the displayed note in a new tab
Match the modal styling to the current theme
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not recommend related notes or learn your interests; it simply picks a random note and shows it at startup.
extras: Upcoming features (command invocation, scroll-to-top button) are listed but not yet implemented; random note display currently happens only on startup.
motivation: The author wanted a way to revisit past notes, reflect on old journal entries, and trigger new ideas from previous learnings.
problem: Obsidian has no way to automatically resurface old notes on startup, so past journal entries and learnings are easily forgotten.
summary: Startup-random-note plugin that shows a random note from your vault in a modal each time Obsidian opens.
